_doc: Which final tokens form each intervention of the person, as [start, end) indices over the final words of each fixture in order. Proposed by the converter (between two agent lines), reviewed against the original by the implementer (spot-checked by the independent reviewer). s3/s4 come when their sessions are named. Each boundary (the start of every intervention but the first) carries its evidence in `boundaries`: `transcript` (the agent spoke between: firm), `old_prompt_only` (only the old engine's prompt between: it reproduces where the old engine cut) or `none` (nothing between). 13.20 scores only `transcript` boundaries, in both directions; the others are reported and decide nothing until the operator reviews them. `discard_candidates`: spans that look like audio that is not the person's (echo, a recording) — I4 candidates, never required whole.
